title: Arcwell Realtime Insights
text:
Arcwell Realtime Insights

crm_notes:
Flag: latency-first fintech data product — microsecond-sensitive rerank pipeline for market signals.
Primary ask: consistent 1–10ms tail latency at 99th percentile for token decode across peaks.
Cost constraint: want ops to run < $0.05 per 1k tokens equivalent for inference baseline; heavy focus on batching and quantization to reach targets.
Architect: 'we'll accept minor quality delta if latency/cost tradeoff is demonstrable' (quote from CTO call).
Interested in Redwood Optimize for autoconfig suggestions (batching thresholds, cache TTL, quant profiles) and benchmarking harness to compare variants under real traffic mix.
Security: enterprise SSO, KMS integration, and retention controls required for audit/compliance; on-prem CISO review pending.
Prefers a Dedicated pool in us-east for throughput but needs fallback to hosted_api in weekend/offhours for burst handling.
Data residency: primary market NA, but EU latency concerns for EU customers; exploring region routing/fallback policies.
Notes from demo: liked KV prefix caching demo — asked about warm-up behavior and cold-cache latency numbers.
AE note: promising POC; procurement cycle depends on perf delta vs current self-hosted stack and 3rd party vendor pricing.
Request: automated perf benchmarking report (p95/p99/token cost) for 3 model variants (base, quant8, quant4-int8) under their sample workload.
This account runs ~150 req/s normal, spiky to 1.5k req/s for 20–40s bursts during market opens — autoscaling and burst credits discussion necessary.

recent_activities:
2026-02-10: Intro call — AE (Ethan) + CTO + Head of ML. Covered product surface and high-level SLA needs.
2026-02-15: Security questionnaire submitted (first pass) — security team requested SOC2 + KMS details.
2026-02-18: Technical deep-dive with SE (Rina) — discussed KV cache, batching heuristics, and quantization strategy.
2026-02-21: Demo of Dedicated pool + Optimize suggestions (live) — team asked for benchmarking against their latency profile.
2026-02-24: Fireflies transcript recorded for POC scoping — meeting id FF-5632-arcw.
2026-02-26: Sent POC plan + pricing deck link; included suggested test harness (perfbench script) and sample traffic generator.
2026-02-27: CISO scheduled compliance review; provided Drive security FAQ doc (drive://redwood/decks/arcwell-security-faq).
2026-02-28: SE created Jira ticket for experimental quantization tests: ARCW-189 (internal).
2026-03-03: Follow-up email thread started re: benchmarking metrics and success criteria (thread id gmail:thread-ARCW-128).
2026-03-05: Received request to show cost per decoded token across 3 model variants (detailed perf matrix).

poc_scope:
Goal: validate 99th percentile latency <= 20ms for 95% of traffic sample during steady-state, with burst handling to 1.5k req/s.
Benchmarks: p50/p90/p95/p99 decode latency, cold vs warmed cache, throughput curves, per-token cost for each variant.
Tech tasks: enable prefix/KV caching; tune continuous batching windows; test quantized kernels (int8/4-bit) with quality regression checks.
Success criteria: latency targets met without doubling token-cost vs baseline OR clear cost/quality tradeoff docs agreed.
Deliverables: automated perf report (HTML + CSV), recommended Optimize config (batch sizes, cache TTLs, quant profile), suggested Dedicated sizing.
Timeline: 4 weeks from kickoff — week 1 infra + traffic replay, week 2 baseline runs, week 3 quant/batching experiments, week 4 final report + review.

next_step:
Schedule POC kickoff (SE + infra + customer) — customer approves SOW; confirm dedicated pool sizing and test data transfer method.

blockers:
CISO has additional questions on key lifecycle and HSM compatibility — awaiting CISO doc review.
Legal needs clearer terms for EU data residency during fallback routing.
Customer wants internal cost-modeling before SOW approval — needs Redwood perf numbers mapped to their token mix.
